translation: I eternally offer my respects unto Śrī Vṛndā Devī, Śrīmatī Tulasī Mahārāṇī, who is the dearmost object of Lord Keśava’s affection. I bow down before Satyavatī who can bestow pure dedication unto Lord Kṛṣṇa.

text: vyāsān jagad-gurūn natvā tato jayam udīrayet
translation: Then, let me bow down before all my spiritual masters: the guru who gave me the divine mantra, as well as all those who have taught me the meaning of *Śrīmad Bhāgavatam*. Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrīla Vyāsadev, the spiritual master of the entire universe and the giver of the all-conquering conclusions of *Śrīmad Bhāgavatam*.
Let the holy lotus feet of Śrī Gurudev, Śrīman Mahāprabhu, and Śrī Śrī Gāndharvā-Govindasundar, along with Their eternal associates, be victorious over all!
